args.name: Preserve gathered food
args.function: Provide a learnable, physically grounded method for reducing spoilage of personally owned edible berries, with explicit material requirements and measurable storage outcomes.
args.conditions: I am outdoors in spring, currently healthy, with six harvested berries. My inventory reports decay on this stack. Berries are known to provide nutrition 8 with toxicity 0. I have no preservation equipment or personally mastered preservation method. Nearby branches and stone are visible but not owned.
args.inputs: Owned berries; any additional materials or equipment must be specified and actually obtained. A small trial batch is preferable.
args.costs: Method, required time, energy, materials, and learning effort are unknown; specify feasible costs and prerequisites.
args.effects: Enable an actual preservation trial and subsequent comparison of spoilage and retained edibility. Do not assume success, grant equipment, or alter food merely through this request.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
candidates.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
candidates.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

candidates.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

packet.access: Search or retrieve only this experiment abilities with control queries. Missing candidates do not prove a function absent. Full implementation facts remain available in the development handoff; never grant inventory or individual mastery. Require actual physical prerequisites.
